description: State Ministry of Production, Supply and Regulation of Pharmaceuticals - Medicines (Pricing of Paracetamol Tablets/Capsules 500mg) Regulations, 2022
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the National Medicines Regulatory Authority Act, establishing pricing controls and regulatory requirements for Paracetamol tablets/capsules. It creates new legal/regulatory frameworks for medication pricing, compliance requirements, and enforcement provisions, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5). While it mentions the Minister of Health by name, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities or make personnel changes, so it does not qualify as a government-related type (1-3).
